feeds.title: Salt Lake City Weekly
feeds.description: Salt Lake City's Weekly Newspaper. Covering Salt Lake City and Utah news, politics, music, film, television and arts; movie times, club calendars, restaurant listings and blogs.

feeds.title: Utah Stories
feeds.description: Utah Stories is about promoting and protecting the power of the individual. The mission is to promote and highlight individuality in a world becoming more homogeneous. The magazine highlights individual success stories and promotes the home grown culture found in Utah.

feeds.title: Utah Money Watch
feeds.description: Get all the latest breaking news stories from Utah right here. Utah Money Watch provides breaking news, analysis, and insights on all aspects of the state of Utah but does so as viewed through a lens of monetary context, impact, and perspective.

feeds.title: Gastronomic Salt Lake City
feeds.description: Gastronomic Salt Lake City is Utah's oldest and biggest online food magazine. Since 2007 they've covered the local food and drink scene in furious detail. They're the only 100% Utah-focused online food magazine. If it's in Utah, and it's worth eating or drinking, you'll read about it here.

feeds.title: Utah Foster Care | The Foster Blog
feeds.description: Utah Foster Care is your starting point for fostering or adopting thru foster care in Utah. We serve Utah's children by finding, educating, and nurturing families to meet the needs of children in foster care.

feeds.title: Better Utah Blog
feeds.description: Better Utah has been and will be there ensuring that there is balance, accountability, and transparency in Utah politics, policy, and government. The mission is to drive a public narrative that empowers Utah's electorate and holds public officials accountable.

feeds.title: SLCeats
feeds.description: SLCeats is a food blog about dining in Salt Lake City, Utah. Ryan Kendrick's words and photos.

feeds.title: Millcreek Gardens | Garden Center, Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Millcreek Gardens of Salt Lake City, Utah is Utah's best garden center and nursery for roses, trees, shrubs, perennials, herbs and vegetables.

feeds.title: La Vida Mom
feeds.description: A single girl, that up until recently, thought the world revolved around her. Now a fiancee and first time mom, I find that the world revolves around my son. Juggling a full time job in a startup company and a side business, keeping my relationship fresh, and trying to keep up with friendships is what my life consists of now.

feeds.title: Everyday Ellis
feeds.description: I'm Karli and he is Kyle! I love fashion. I teach kindergarten. Everyday Ellis is a modest fashion blog based in Salt Lake City, UT. Here you'll find modest outfit inspirations, newlywed adventures, and details on our crazy love story.

feeds.title: Momstrong Blog
feeds.description: Momstrong is a community of strong women like yourself. As women, we are all mothers, no matter our circumstance. We have the ability and gifts to influence those around us in a positive way. Here, you'll find access to training packages, at-home workouts, delicious and nutritious recipes, group hikes for women, and tips on living a holistic and healthy lifestyle.

feeds.title: Explore Park City Blog
feeds.description: Find information to help plan your Park City, Utah vacation. Park City Utah visitor information that includes hotels and lodging, ski and snowboarding, restaurants, events, snow conditions and weather, discounts and more

feeds.title: The Salt Lake Tribune
feeds.description: Utah's independent news source since 1871, The Salt Lake Tribune covers news, entertainment, sports and faith for Salt Lake City and the state of Utah.

feeds.title: KnowGrow
feeds.description: Your search for reliable tech answers ends here. KnowGrow's platform provides expert solutions to all your tech-related queries. From troubleshooting common issues to exploring the latest tech trends, you are covered. Explore tips, tricks, and tutorials on everything tech-related, from desktops and laptops to social media and gadgets.

feeds.title: Tanya Corinne | Utah Fashion and Lifestyle Blogger
feeds.description: I'm Tanya Corinne, a 20-something year old, born and raised in California and now living in Utah with my husband and our 2 fur babies. My blog was created as a way to document the things I love and has become a creative outlet where I share my personal style through outfits, travel, beauty, and much more!

feeds.title: Get Real Utah
feeds.description: A dynamic business directory for Utah Businesses and those they connect with.

feeds.title: Indie Ogden Utah
feeds.description: Your source for all things Ogden! Indie Ogden shares all the best local events and happenings, spotlights on local businesses, cool locals of interest, reviews and so much more. If you thought you knew Ogden, think again and check out Indie Ogden to see what you've been missing.
